statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
The service involves mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229).
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period.
The non-sustained nature of the symptoms necessitates extended rhythm correlation.
